title: The Mirror Pool
text: Still water, black as a mirror and just as smooth, though rain is falling everywhere else. In it each of you sees yourself the way your card would be if it were turned the other way up. Your reflections do not blink when you do.

options.label: Look into the black water, and meet the eyes of who you might have been.

outcomes.text: The reflection nods slowly. Something it knows passes over into you.
The reflection smiles before you do. Long after you look away, you can feel it smiling still.

options.label: Look away, and do not meet its unblinking eyes.

outcomes.text: You keep your eyes on the far bank until the pool lies behind you. You arrive still wholly yourself.
